audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-pitched female laughter and fast-paced speech open the track. A bright acoustic guitar and piano BGM starts immediately. Background cafe chatter is faintly audible. (2) Vocal transitions to a theatrical, exaggerated sobbing tone while describing a movie. The BGM maintains a steady, happy rhythm despite the crying sounds. (3) Outdoor ambient noise floor rises slightly during a jogging sequence. Breathiness and light physical strain are audible in the vocal delivery. (4) A sharp digital 'Ding' SFX and a comedic buzzer-like 'Stop' SFX punctuate the dance studio sequence. Multiple female voices laugh in unison. (5) Acoustic texture shifts to a professional event setting with a male voice speaking over a microphone, exhibiting room reverberation and a lower pitch floor. (6) Sudden 'Whoosh' transition SFX accompanies rapid visual cuts. The BGM remains the anchoring layer, while short bursts of high-arousal female shouting and giggling occur as she meets friends. (7) Narrative voice returns to a calm, friendly conversational tone while eating. Sounds of utensils clinking against ceramics are heard at a low intensity. (8) The audio concludes with a high-energy goodbye phrase and a final upbeat musical flourish.
